node.label: Daniel T Rodgers
node.date_label: Contested Truths (1987) · Atlantic Crossings (1998) · Age of Fracture (2011)
node.description: A historian of American ideas and transatlantic social politics. His Age of Fracture account follows the fragmentation of social thought across disciplines and policy, including the move from institutions and interdependence toward choice and flexible selves.

proposed_edges.relationship: Links shifting concepts of obligation and choice to arguments over social provision and public policy.
